PowerShell($urls = @\('https://maisontislit.com/site.webmanifest','https://maisontislit.com/favicon.webp','https://maisontislit.com/favicon-48.webp'\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -Method Head -TimeoutSec 20; $ct = $r.Headers['Content-Type']; if \(-not $ct\) { $ct = $r.Content.Headers.ContentType } ; Write-Output "$u`t$status=$\($r.StatusCode\)`tcontent-type=$ct" } catch { Write-Output "$u`tERROR`t$\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
